brief:
More than 200,000 protesters gathered in Amsterdam to demonstrate against the conflict in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The march drew demonstrators calling on the Netherlands to halt arms sales to Israel, impose tighter sanctions, and officially recognize what participants characterize as genocide in Gaza.

The demonstration reflected growing activism across Europe regarding Israeli military operations. Organizers framed the action as a demand for Dutch government policy shifts on arms transfers and international recognition of the humanitarian crisis.
